items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: That’s when he punched Jimmy Knepper in the mouth. And I asked Jimmy how did that happen.

ctx.x: Yeah they recorded that. But what happened was they pushed the date up a month, which hung him up about writing the music. That’s when he punched Jimmy Knepper in the mouth. And I asked Jimmy how did that happen. He said he was copying music for him and he went up to bring him some music and Mingus says, “write me something.” So he says, “it’s your concert, it’s not my concert.” Bamm. You know.
I guess he was under a little pressure.
